provenance.sceneDurationSec: computed from startS/endS of all 33 entries in harness/reference/lamina/index.json (median 18.5, p25 17.5, p75 19.5, range 10.5-28.5)
provenance.sampleFramesPerScene: every index.json entry lists 6 sampleTimesS values; used only as a sampling cadence, not a measured reveal count
provenance.revealTargetBand: parity target centred on the 6-frame sampling cadence (6 +/- 1); not a claim about reference internals
provenance.boardCoverageBand: observed end-of-scene coverage in OBSERVATIONS.md composition notes (50-70% of frame)
provenance.revealOrder: observed drawing order in OBSERVATIONS.md (outline first, then fill); describes frames only, not how the reference was built

notes: Observations describe reference frames only, not reference implementation.
Do not use for pixel similarity or visual-acceptance scoring.
